bug_semantics: Yii 2 View::renderPhpFile() extracts caller-supplied $_params_ with EXTR_OVERWRITE in the same local scope as the include path $_file_, then require's that variable. A params key named _file_ therefore overwrites the intended view path and becomes a local-file-inclusion primitive (arbitrary non-PHP file read; RCE only if a separate write primitive already placed PHP on disk). ErrorHandler::renderFile() had the same extract/require collision and was patched with the same isolation. Attack path is Controller/Widget renderFile/renderPhpFile (or the error-handler fallback) with attacker-influenced params; CVSS AC:H matches that the caller must pass a _file_ key. Affected: < 2.0.55 (2.0.54 still has the in-scope extract/require). Patched: 2.0.55.
flaw_origin: The colliding combination first appears in 269ce903bdfb3a41e2a5b2cfc8e47bb898e54481 (2012-04-15, Qiang Xue), which introduced protected renderFileInternal($_file_, $_params_) doing extract($_params_, EXTR_OVERWRITE); require($_file_). The immediate parent still extracted with EXTR_OVERWRITE but required $this->file (an object property, not a local), so a _file_ param could not retarget the include. An even earlier draft (e585c69, 2012-04-04) used require($_file_) with EXTR_PREFIX_SAME and an explicit anti-collision comment, which is not this LFI. Later Yii2 history only renamed/inlined that function (renderFileInternal -> renderFile -> renderPhpFile) or equivalently overwrote locals (2016 HHVM foreach polyfill, immediately reverted); those are not BICs.

GHSA-5vpg-rj7q-qpw2 withdrawn_at=null, vulnerable_version_range='< 2.0.55', first_patched_version=2.0.55.

Pre-fix View::renderPhpFile at 109878b491dbffa541032bc99fb5e26d12cd0375^ (framework/base/View.php:341-348): extract($_params_, EXTR_OVERWRITE); try { require $_file_; }. Pre-fix ErrorHandler::renderFile (framework/web/ErrorHandler.php:258-265) uses the same extract then require Yii::getAlias($_file_).

Fix 109878b491dbffa541032bc99fb5e26d12cd0375 (Alexander Makarov <sam@rmcreative.ru>, 2026-05-09) isolates extract/require inside a closure using func_get_arg(0/1) so extracted _file_ cannot clobber the include path; also adds tests/framework/base/ViewTest.php::testRenderFileDoesNotAllowInternalFileOverride (renderFile($viewFile, ['_file_' => $secretFile]) must still render the safe view) and the ErrorHandler analogue. CHANGELOG: 'Bug: CVE-2026-39850, Isolate internal variables in View::renderPhpFile() and ErrorHandler::renderFile()'.

BIC 269ce903bdfb3a41e2a5b2cfc8e47bb898e54481 is a single-parent non-merge commit (parent 9d1b97189d44fd4d323253196f654917b0147826). git cat-file -p shows only author/committer Qiang Xue <qiang.xue@gmail.com> and message 'view.'; no trailers. It first adds protected function renderFileInternal($_file_, $_params_ = array()) { extract($_params_, EXTR_OVERWRITE); ob_start(); ob_implicit_flush(false); require($_file_); return ob_get_clean(); }.

Parent-tree verification: 9d1b97189d44fd4d323253196f654917b0147826:framework/base/View.php exists; git grep require($_file_) on that tree is empty; render() does extract($_params_, EXTR_OVERWRITE) then require($this->file) with no $_file_ local. git grep _file_ on the parent View.php is empty. git grep require($_file_) at the BIC hits only framework/base/View.php:126.

Not earlier drafts: e585c69fbbfa2c5d096c7661e0cb3293f4da3f21 (2012-04-04) used extract($_data_, EXTR_PREFIX_SAME, 'data'); require($_file_); which does not overwrite $_file_. cf6d2699540f8148c197d0d97a1819216b451d33 switched to EXTR_OVERWRITE but required $this->file. 269ce903 recombined OVERWRITE with a local $_file_ include target — first write of this LFI.

Later history is rename/inline/style, not a new first-write: bd320533ab85e45333ad1222a37787c52119bed8 (2013-01-30) inlined renderFileInternal into renderFile; e3c85b478ea06a18f87256ae0b087055914a7f86 (2013-02-01) split a renderer dispatcher and kept extract/require in the new renderPhpFile; 0c38655217fe1d8330dea8661902db4d90e5e559 is a PSR-4 path move. f7bd7c2b6b1b9941e3c50d99e4f07ff17d513cca replaced extract with foreach (${$key} = $value) — still overwrites $_file_ — and eb02b362be7050a313e7a5f0636e6171e7969c16 reverted it the next day. 0beb59305c638d2c8c0dbff9962a0a860f405ac4 wrapped require in try/catch; a50d9d8e3eb0d689d02bdbf4c3fce6f14ffa0be5 is require() style.

Tag membership: git merge-base --is-ancestor 269ce903bdfb3a41e2a5b2cfc8e47bb898e54481 2.0.0 succeeds (BIC precedes first 2.0 release and the whole < 2.0.55 range). 2.0.54:framework/base/View.php:340-347 still has extract + require $_file_. git merge-base --is-ancestor 109878b491dbffa541032bc99fb5e26d12cd0375 2.0.54 fails; the same ancestor check vs annotated tag 2.0.55 (peeled babee66def599432735a1ed39c9cf0bc5163a775, 2026-05-09) succeeds. 2.0.55 renderPhpFile uses the closure isolation.

Attack path at the fix parent: View::renderFile() (framework/base/View.php:224) resolves the view then calls $this->renderPhpFile($viewFile, $params) for PHP views, passing caller params straight through.
reasoning: The advisory and the published CVE-2026-39850 record describe a real CWE-98 local-file-inclusion in View::renderPhpFile(): extract($_params_, EXTR_OVERWRITE) runs in the same function scope as local $_file_, so a caller-controlled params key _file_ replaces the path used by require. That is not a withdrawn/rejected CVE (MITRE state PUBLISHED; GHSA withdrawn_at is null). The 2.0.54 tree still has the in-scope extract/require; 2.0.55 contains 109878b491dbffa541032bc99fb5e26d12cd0375, which moves extract/require into a closure fed by func_get_arg so extracted variables cannot collide with the include path (ErrorHandler::renderFile received the same treatment as a sibling copy of the pattern). Regression tests assert renderFile(..., ['_file_' => $secretFile]) cannot read the secret file. Walking git log -L / blame / -S on the pre-fix function, the colliding locals are not born in the 2026 fix, the 2017 try/catch wrap, the 2016 HHVM extract polyfill/revert, or the 2013 renderPhpFile rename. Those commits either restyle, equivalently overwrite locals, or move already-vulnerable lines. The smallest first-write is 269ce903bdfb3a41e2a5b2cfc8e47bb898e54481, which added renderFileInternal($_file_, $_params_) with extract OVERWRITE plus require($_file_). Its immediate parent 9d1b97189d44fd4d323253196f654917b0147826 still requires $this->file after extract, so the LFI collision is absent there (direct parent-tree grep). That BIC is a regular single-parent commit, not a squash/merge whose members can be decomposed.
